summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing repurchases under its previously announced buyback program. Between September 14 and September 18, 2026, the Belgian biotech bought 108,679 ordinary shares through a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary at a volume-weighted average price of €24.00, totaling €2,608,832.08, with prices ranging €23.16–€25.44. As of September 18, 2026, Lakefront holds 1,527,534 own shares. No board recommendation or advisor is named beyond the intermediary. Watch for continued daily repurchase disclosures, treasury-share accumulation relative to outstanding capital, and any impact on liquidity or overhang.
